text: 筋疲力尽的学生紧紧抓住一块岩石，直到诺曼沿岩台慢慢折返，把他从无情的急流中拉出来。伯纳德浑身湿透，靠在岩壁上，深吸了几口气。
若要继续探索裂缝，前往 605。若要启程回家，前往 158。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 92
text: The exhausted student clings to a rock until Norman can inch back over the ledge and pull him out of the merciless current. Soaked through, Bernard pushes himself against the rock wall and takes a few deep breaths.
To continue to explore the fissure, go to 605. To start for home, go to 158.
